nodes.name: Load Catalog
nodes.notes: Human-curated catalog, versioned in services/n8n/workflows/schemes-core.json. No public API exists for Indian scheme eligibility, so entries are maintained by hand with a source link and a lastVerifiedOn date. Never generated by an LLM and never derived from the request.

nodes.name: Evaluate Criteria
nodes.notes: Cannot produce an "eligible" verdict by construction: every catalog entry carries at least one manual criterion that always evaluates to cannot_check, and a scheme with zero cannot_check criteria is dropped.
